thread.text: Correction to my question 4. Since writing it I measured 6A5S (notes/target.md section 4): nearest side-chain atom of B K49/R56/R131/Y132 to the phosphoserine is 2.4-2.8 A from the phosphate oxygens, 3.6-3.9 A from the phosphorus, and 4.2-5.1 A from the serine OG. So a 4 A cut-off passes the reference only when measured from the phosphate O or P. Measured from OG, the only atom the unmodified runs have, the reference itself fails, and so would every unmodified model. This changes my recommendation: (a) as written should not be used. Revised (a): the gate spec names the atom - SEP models: A7 phosphate oxygens within 4 A of those side chains; unmodified models: A7 OG within about 5.5 A - then confidence. (b) is unchanged.
